trigger.independent_qa_finding: The strictly ordered oracle and actual include-all-ties explainer were calibrated on different per-molecule cardinality schedules, so separately calibrated mean retained fractions did not define a capacity lower bound.

correction: At every fraction-grid point and for every molecule, compute the actual include-all-ties selected cardinality first, then construct the rationale-first oracle with exactly that cardinality. This guarantees pointwise oracle loss no greater than actual loss on a shared monotone schedule, an oracle CRC index no later than the actual CRC index, and nonnegative capacity excess.
